note: The Settings screen (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 26): its sections, which options each lists and in what order, the words for each choice, and the screen's own words. The controls themselves (default, range, step, choices, label, help) come from options.json: a toggle for a boolean, a slider for a number with min and max, a choice for a list. An item may also be an action button. needs: a feature flag in features.json; until it is on the row is dimmed and marked Soon, and the screen skips it. remap: the Remap controls screen (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 27): its words, with {action}, {control}, {other} and {layout} filled in. hidden: options that stay in options.json (and the HUD's options) but not on this screen.
title: SETTINGS
hint_keys: Up and Down: choose.  Left and Right: change.  Enter: switch.  Esc: close.
hint_pad: D-pad: choose and change.  A: switch.  B: close.

items.label: Remap controls
items.help: Change which button or key does what, for the layout you are using.

items.label: Remap player 2's controls
items.help: Change which button or key does what for player two, when two people play.

items.label: Flashing effects notice
items.help: The notice shown when the game starts: it contains flashing effects, what Reduced motion does and does not change, and that no independent photosensitivity analyzer has been run.

remap.title: REMAP CONTROLS
remap.layout_help: Pick the layout to change. Each layout keeps its own keys or buttons.
remap.reset_help: Put every key or button of this layout back the way it came.
remap.hint_keys: Up and Down: choose.  Enter: change.  Left and Right: other layout.  Esc: back.
remap.hint_pad: D-pad: choose.  A: change.  Left and right: other layout.  B: back.
remap.capture_key: Press the key for {action}.  Esc cancels.
remap.capture_pad: Press the button for {action}.  Start cancels.
remap.reserved: {control} is kept for the game. Pick another.
remap.pair: {control} belongs to the other player's keys. Pick another.
remap.wrong_device_kb: That was not a key. Press a key.
remap.wrong_device_pad: That was not a controller button. Press a button.

helps.move: The four keys that fly you. Press them in order: up, left, down, right.
helps.light: A quick blow. Also the first special while Power is held.
helps.heavy: A slow, hard blow. Also the second special while Power is held.
helps.signature: Your signature move, when you have the Charge for it.
helps.dodge: Tap to dodge, hold to sprint.
helps.power: Hold to charge. Held with a face button it calls a special.
helps.mode: Hold for energy attacks: blasts instead of blows. Let go for physical. Settings can make it a toggle.
helps.context: The move that fits the moment, such as a grab. The third special while Power is held.
helps.escape: A way out of a fight.
helps.transform: Takes a form that is ready: hold it for half a second.

helps_toggle.guard: Press to guard, press again to stop.
helps_toggle.dodge: Tap to dodge. Press once for the manoeuvre stance and its sprint, press again to stop.
helps_toggle.power: Press to start charging, press again to stop. Pressed with a face button it calls a special.
helps_toggle.mode: Press for energy attacks: blasts instead of blows. Press again for physical.
helps_toggle.transform: Takes a form that is ready: press the controls together once and let go, and it comes half a second later.
